"summary": "A) Conclusion (TL;DR)
- Yesterday’s summary
  - OpenClaw gateway is up + reachable locally (systemd running; dashboard http://127.0.0.1:18789/). Cron system is active and Mission Control feed updater has been running OK.
  - Repeated integration noise in logs: multiple `web_fetch failed: fetch failed` and prior weather API 400 (“latitude/longitude must have same number of elements”). Workspace root git repo has **no commits yet** (audit trail weak).

- Today’s top improvements (1–3)
  1) Standardize “Health Check SOP” (single checklist: openclaw status + cron list/runs + log tail + GitHub status) to reduce debugging time.
  2) Reduce flaky external fetch impact: add stricter URL validation + better error surfacing for `web_fetch` failures (especially weather/news inputs).
  3) Decide + implement a basic git workflow for `/workspace` (at least commit docs/config), so changes are reviewable.

- Executed changes (safe)
  - Created today’s daily log placeholder to prevent recurring “missing daily memory file” errors:
    - `memory/2026-03-06.md`

- Risks/blockers + anything needing Alvin approval (money-related only)
  - Money-related approvals: none requested.
  - Non-money notes: OpenClaw update available (reported by `openclaw status`: “npm update 2026.3.2”); schedule intentionally if desired. Security audit warns Discord slash commands have no allowlists configured (expected behavior: commands rejected unless allowlisted).

B) Minutes (detail)

[03:00] Health Review
- OpenClaw status
  - Command: `openclaw status`
  - Key outputs (evidence)
    - Gateway service: systemd enabled + running; RPC probe OK
    - Gateway bind: loopback `127.0.0.1:18789`; Dashboard: `http://127.0.0.1:18789/`
    - Update available: “npm update 2026.3.2”
    - Security audit: 0 critical; warnings include:
      - “Reverse proxy headers are not trusted” (only matters if exposing UI behind a proxy)
      - “Discord slash commands have no allowlists”
- Cron overview
  - Command: cron list (to…",
2026-03-07T13:00:38.525Z error [tools] web_fetch failed: Web fetch failed (400): SECURITY NOTICE: The following content is from an EXTERNAL, UNTRUSTED source (e.g., email, webhook).

"message": "Update Mission Control status feed by running:

cd /home/claw/.openclaw/workspace/my-project && node scripts/update-status.mjs --push

If it fails, report the error output.",

"message": "Create the daily morning briefing for Alvin to post in Discord #general. Keep it concise, bullet-style.

Include 3 sections:
1) HK Weather today + tomorrow (short, actionable; mention rain/thunderstorm likelihood and temps).
   - Prefer: https://wttr.in/Hong_Kong?format=j1 (JSON) or https://wttr.in/Hong_Kong?1 (text).
   - Avoid lat/long API calls that can error (e.g., latitude/longitude length mismatch). If fetch fails, say “Weather: unavailable right now (fetch failed).”
2) MTR service status (check https://www.mtr.com.hk/alert/ryg_line_status_lite.xml).
   - If all lines are green (or grey for ended service), say: “MTR: No major delays reported (as of <time>).”
   - If any line is yellow/red/typhoon/other non-green status, list the affected line(s) with the status and any message text.
3) 3–5 bullets of OpenClaw/AI setup + productivity + cost-saving tips.

End with: “Anything you want me to prioritize today?”",
